title: OrjusDowned
description: Rust-like downed/revive mechanic: players enter a downed state instead of dying instantly, can crawl, and wait for a revive. If not revived in time, they die. Fully configurable in config.yml.
body: ![4Foto](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d69886eabc99fac7206dd78705f3d55c1e00d837.png) # OrjusDowned **rjusDowned** adds a Rust-like **downed/revive system** to Paper servers. Instead of dying instantly from lethal damage, players enter a **downed state**: they can slowly crawl, wait for help, and be revived by nearby players before the bleedout timer expires. If nobody helps in time — or a finishing hit is allowed — the player dies normally. ## Features - Rust-inspired downed/revive mechanic - Crawling while downed - Configurable bleedout timer - Player revive system - Optional finishing hits - Block actions while downed - Configurable revive requirements - Instant-death damage causes - Custom sounds & effects - Full English & Russian localization - Folia support - Fully configurable via `config.yml` and `messages.yml` ## Configuration Everything can be customized: - Bleedout duration - Crawl speed & pose - Revive range and conditions - Sneak-to-revive mechanic - Optional revive item cost - Allowed/blocked actions - Instant-death damage causes - Sounds and messages ## Localization The plugin includes full localization support through `messages.yml`: - English - Russian
